label: Trebuchet
description: One early medieval-style counterweight trebuchet: long reinforced oak base rails, two sturdy A-frame supports seen only from their horizontal top beams, long north-south throwing arm with a boxy stone counterweight at its short north end and a long slack sling with a stone at its south end. Its extended arm, counterweight box and sling form the distinctive silhouette. No torsion bundle or spoon bucket. Exactly FOUR early medieval crew in muted green and ochre wool, steel helmet crowns and leather belts around the outer sides of the machine. Compact mobile RTS carriage on four thin upright wheel rims. No side-view tall triangular elevation.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Top-down RTS unit animation sprite atlas for Age of Fronts.
Produce a square 1254 x 1254 RGBA image with exactly FOUR sprites in a precise 2 by 2 grid, read left to right then the next row. Each of the four equal 627 x 627 cells contains ONE complete weapon with its crew. The four sprites are consecutive animation poses of the SAME unit, not different designs.
Camera is a strict vertical overhead orthographic view, optical axis exactly perpendicular to the ground, pitch -90 degrees. This is an overhead battlefield sprite, with no horizon or ground patch. Only horizontal weapon tops, helmet crowns, hair crowns, shoulders, forearms and shoes are visible. Crew faces, chest fronts and vertical torso fronts are invisible. Large vertical weapon walls, upright wheel circular side faces, wheels' spoke discs, human faces, angled human portraits or standing facades must never appear.
Every weapon aims at the TOP of its cell, perfectly vertical along the screen Y axis. Top of each crew member's head seen from above, bodies arranged realistically around the weapon. Exactly the same number of crew with matching clothing in all four frames. No rotating camera or changing design.
Materials: crisp polished hand-painted RTS art, natural weathered timber grain, iron or bronze fitting textures, readable outlines, realistic proportions, restrained short contact shadows directly beneath forms. Clean alpha silhouette. Moderate detail readable at small game scale.
Grid/framing: Machine center and crew arrangement remain at exactly the same coordinates in all four equal cells. Complete silhouette fits inside each cell with at least 50 pixels of fully empty transparent margin on each side, including poles, crew, weapon muzzle and loose effects. Clear transparent gutters through the center lines. No tile borders, labels, numbers, UI, watermark or checkerboard/white/black painted background. Alpha outside subjects is actually transparent.
Important overhead geometry: Upright carriage wheels are viewed only as narrow elongated top tire/rim bands beside the axle, never as upright circular discs with spokes. Raised beams show their top surfaces. Canopy roofs occlude supports. The output must read as a straight-down game map sprite, not a miniature photographed at an angle.
Input image is ONLY the overhead camera, small crew treatment and detailed painted game style reference. Do not copy its weapon, materials, uniforms or age. Replace with this unit in all four cells:
UNIT: One early medieval-style counterweight trebuchet: long reinforced oak base rails, two sturdy A-frame supports seen only from their horizontal top beams, long north-south throwing arm with a boxy stone counterweight at its short north end and a long slack sling with a stone at its south end. Its extended arm, counterweight box and sling form the distinctive silhouette. No torsion bundle or spoon bucket. Exactly FOUR early medieval crew in muted green and ochre wool, steel helmet crowns and leather belts around the outer sides of the machine. Compact mobile RTS carriage on four thin upright wheel rims. No side-view tall triangular elevation.
ANIMATION: Four subtle IDLE poses. Weapon geometry is identical, immobile and aligned in all four cells. Crew perform only tiny breathing and hand adjustments. Frame 1 neutral, frame 2 inhale, frame 3 settle, frame 4 neutral. Same exact crew count and clothing in every cell. No attack, launches, muzzle flash or smoke. Keep complete weapons and crew within their equal cells with clean transparent gutters.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is a 2x2 atlas of the exact weapon unit with its crew. Make a new animation atlas by changing ONLY the action poses. Preserve that same unit identity, palette, uniforms, detailed painted texture, strict vertical overhead camera, 1254 x 1254 image and exactly FOUR equal 627 x 627 cells.
Keep the rigid chassis, wheel bands, tripod or base footprint at the SAME SCALE AND COORDINATES in all four cells. Do not zoom, change proportion, shift the whole sprite or redraw it as another machine. Only the specified mechanical components and crew joints move. The camera stays pitch -90 degrees; faces and wheel side discs remain invisible. All weapons still face straight NORTH.
Four consecutive poses are read left to right then the next row. Each weapon and crew is complete within its cell. Keep clear transparent gutters and at least 25 pixels of alpha margin. Small projectiles, flashes and smoke stay fully inside the same cell. Gun muzzle flashes are TINY, at most about 20 pixels across; smoke puffs at most about 35 pixels across, placed close to the muzzle. Never fill a cell with smoke or paint across a grid boundary.
Genuine transparency around subjects; no tile lines, labels, numbers, background, watermark, ground tile or big explosion.
Unit: Trebuchet, EarlyMedieval, exactly 4 crew.
Action: Movement.
Four in-place marching/pushing poses around the mobile base. All FOUR crew alternate left step, passing, right step, passing, arms pushing the side base rails. The trebuchet throwing arm is LATCHED and unmoving in its travel position; counterweight, sling, supports and base stay fixed and matching the idle design. No launch or smoke. Keep the whole unit centered and aimed north; world translation is external.
